title: CLAUDE.md documents a make target that does not exist
body: The new CLAUDE.md instructs agents/developers to run 'make bundle' as part of the standard workflow and "before every release" (line 12), but the repo's Makefile defines no 'bundle' target (verified: grep -n 'bundle' Makefile matches nothing; targets present are install, lint, test, check, build, agent-rules, etc.). Any agent or developer following these instructions will run 'make: *** No rule to make target 'bundle'.  Stop.' This is a contract-drift defect: the documentation makes a false claim about the build system's capabilities. Either add a real 'bundle' target to the Makefile or remove/replace this instruction with an existing target (e.g. 'make build').
